item.title: Obituary - Sybil Mills
item.description: Sybil Mills, 85 of Harrisonville, Missouri passed away Thursday, February 26, 2026 at her home in Harrisonville. Funeral services are pending at this time. Services under the direction of Mullinax Funeral Home, Drexel (816-657-4400). Memorial contributions may be made to the National Kidney Foundation. Messages of condolence may be left for the family at www.mullinaxfuneralhome.com.A complete obituary is pending at this time. #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Obituary - Chester “Lee” Bowen
item.description: Chester “Lee” Bowen, 96, Nevada, MO passed away on Tuesday, January 26, 2026, at Moore-Few Care Center in Nevada. item.title: Rapid response saves Butler home
item.description: Shortly before 1:30 this afternoon the Butler fire department was called to 715 Country Club drive on a report of heavy smoke showing from the rear of the residence. Upon arrival, firemen made quick work of dousing the flames which appeared to be contained to the deck area.As crews remain on the scene at this time, the cause is yet to be determined. #MidAmericaLive

Bates County Memorial Rock Star of the Month
item.description: Congratulations to Kate Long, RN, our February Rock Star! Kate works in Outpatient Specialty Clinics, helping patients in the Long-Nissen Infusion Center. She was nominated for this recognition by a coworker for being consistently calm, compassionate, and professional, with a strong bedside manner and dedication to patient advocacy. Thank you, Kate, for your skill and dedication! #MidAmericaLive
